ownership.quote: Nvidia confirmed today that it has acquired Hugging Face for $12.93 billion.

stage.quote: AI startup Hugging Face has raised $235 million in a Series D funding round
stage.note: Last priced VC round was the Aug 2023 Series D. As of Sept 2026 Hugging Face has agreed to be acquired by Nvidia for ~$12.93B (deal expected to close H1 2027, pending regulatory approval); it is not yet a wholly-owned subsidiary, so 'acquired' is recorded as ownership but stage reflects the last priced funding round.

accelerators.name: Station F
accelerators.quote: listed in the Station F portfolio as "Hugging Face"

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of publicly reported rounds (seed, Series A/B/C, and the $235M Series D) as aggregated by Crunchbase/press; no single primary source states a consolidated lifetime total.

last_round.quote: The tranche, which had participation from Google, Amazon, Nvidia, Intel, AMD, Qualcomm, IBM, Salesforce and Sound Ventures, values Hugging Face at $4.5 billion.

revenue.basis: Reported by TechCrunch coverage of the Nvidia acquisition and reflected as company revenue on Wikipedia (2025 figure carried forward).
revenue.quote: Hugging Face is clocking $150 million in annualized revenue.

note: On Sept 3, 2026 Nvidia confirmed it will acquire Hugging Face for ~$12.93B (~$11.9B cash plus up to $1B in employee retention equity), deal expected to close H1 2027 pending regulatory approval; Hugging Face is to keep its brand and remain an open, hardware-agnostic platform. This card covers 'Hugging Face Jobs', a compute-on-demand product (CPU/GPU containers billed per second) inside the broader Hugging Face Hub/platform, not a separately-funded entity.
